templates.title: Upbeat pop song
templates.description: A bright, radio-friendly pop song with a big singalong chorus.

examples.topic: a summer road trip with old friends
examples.instruments: bright synths, punchy drums and clean electric guitar

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Upbeat modern pop about [topic], [instruments], catchy hook, polished radio mix, confident lead vocal

templates.title: Qawwali
templates.description: Devotional Sufi qawwali with harmonium, tabla, handclaps and a call-and-response chorus.

examples.theme: longing for the beloved and the light of the dargah at night

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Sufi qawwali about [theme], harmonium and tabla, rhythmic handclaps, group chorus answering the lead singer, slow build to an ecstatic finale, live [setting] feel

templates.title: Ghazal
templates.description: An intimate Urdu ghazal: soft harmonium, tabla and a tender, unhurried voice.

examples.theme: a lover waiting by the window as the monsoon rain falls

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Classical Urdu ghazal about [theme], soft harmonium, gentle tabla, [instrument] fills, intimate late-night baithak, expressive unhurried vocal

templates.title: Bollywood-style romance
templates.description: A sweeping film-song duet with strings, dholak and a soaring chorus.

examples.scene: two lovers meeting again at a crowded railway station

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Romantic Bollywood-style film song duet about [scene], lush strings, dholak and tabla groove, flute melody, [era] film-song feel, soaring chorus

templates.title: Brand jingle
templates.description: A short, cheerful jingle that sings the brand name and a tagline.

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Cheerful advertising jingle for [brand], ukulele, handclaps and glockenspiel, bright and friendly, ends on the line [tagline]

templates.title: Epic trailer score
templates.description: Orchestral build with taiko hits and a huge final rise for a trailer or finale.

examples.story: a lone rider crossing a frozen mountain pass

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Epic cinematic trailer score for [story], low string ostinato, taiko drums, brass stabs, choir rising to [ending], no vocals

templates.title: Lo-fi background bed
templates.description: Calm lo-fi hip-hop to sit under a vlog, tutorial or study video.

examples.mood: a rainy afternoon in a small café

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Lo-fi hip-hop instrumental, [mood], [instrument], dusty drums, warm vinyl crackle, soft bass, relaxed and steady

templates.title: Sitar and tabla
templates.description: An unhurried South Asian instrumental with sitar, tanpura drone and tabla.

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Indian classical instrumental for [time], sitar melody over a tanpura drone, gentle tabla entering halfway, [mood] and spacious

templates.title: Transition whoosh
templates.description: A fast whoosh to cut between two shots or titles.

examples.texture: airy with a soft metallic shimmer

defaults.prompt_scaffold: A single [speed] cinematic whoosh transition, [texture], clean tail, no music

templates.title: Footsteps
templates.description: Footsteps on a surface you choose, at walking pace.

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Footsteps of [shoes] walking at a steady pace on [surface], close-miked foley, no music

templates.title: City at night
templates.description: Distant traffic, voices and the hum of a city after dark.

examples.detail: rickshaws passing and a distant call to prayer

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Night-time city ambience in [city], distant traffic, murmuring voices, [detail], wide stereo, no music

templates.title: Monsoon rain
templates.description: Steady monsoon rain with rolling thunder, for calm scenes or sleep.

examples.place: a tin-roofed veranda in a village

defaults.prompt_scaffold: Heavy monsoon rain on [place], water dripping from the eaves, [extra], immersive and steady, no music
